title: Loksewa Overview & Exam Pattern
notes:
What is Loksewa?

The Loksewa Aayog (Public Service Commission of Nepal) is the constitutional body that selects and recruits civil servants for the Government of Nepal through open, inclusive and competitive examinations.

Key Facts

  • Established under the Constitution of Nepal (Part 23, Articles 242–244; PSC first established in 1951).
  • Conducts exams for Gazetted and Non-Gazetted officer and staff posts.
  • Exams include General Knowledge Paper (G.K.), Nepal Civil Service Acts, and subject-specific papers.

Exam Papers (Typical)

  • Paper 1: General Knowledge — Nepal affairs, current affairs, geography, history, science.
  • Paper 2: Public Service Act, Civil Service Act 2049, and rules.
  • Paper 3: Subject-specific (per post).
